title: Copy — every rendered character on every page
objective: Character-level audit of everything a visitor or Rick can READ: every text node on every public page and every admin page, plus <title>s, meta descriptions, alt text, aria-labels, placeholder text, button labels, and form error strings. Typos, encoding artifacts, punctuation drift, casing drift, factual-consistency contradictions between pages. The unit of inspection is the character; the unit of judgment is what a spec-grade buyer or Rick would notice.

steps.do: Write _harness/audit10-textdump.js: for every page in routes.json (public + all 42 products + admin GET pages, desktop-1440), walk the DOM and emit every visible text node (skip script/style/[hidden]/[aria-hidden] separators), PLUS document.title, meta[name=description], every img[alt], every [aria-label], every ::placeholder, every button/summary/label textContent. Output: plans/audit10/state/textdump.json — {url: [{text, path}]} — committed, so later passes and the remediation plan can grep it.

Mechanical scans over the dump (write them as code, not eyeballing): (a) encoding artifacts: mojibake sequences (Ã, â€™, â€œ, Â), literal &/"/' rendering as text, replacement chars (U+FFFD); (b) whitespace: double spaces inside sentences, leading/trailing space inside inline elements where it renders, space-before-punctuation; (c) punctuation pairing: unbalanced quotes/parens/brackets per text node; (d) dash/quote inventory: straight vs curly quotes, hyphen-as-em-dash (' - ' mid-sentence), en/em usage — report DRIFT (mixed styles in the same context class), not a style opinion; (e) repeated words ('the the'); (f) sentence-terminal drift within the same component class (some card blurbs end with '.', siblings do not).

Spelling sweep: extract the unique word list from the dump; check against a wordlist (aspell/hunspell if available on the box, else a curated pass over the unique-unknown-words list — the list is small enough to read in full and MUST be read in full). Domain terms (heat-shrink vocabulary, SKUs, UL/CSA/MIL-SPEC, polyolefin etc.) are expected — the deliverable is real misspellings, each verified in the rendered page before recording.

Casing and terminology consistency: (a) heading case per component class (all page <h1>s, all section eyebrows, all card titles — same case convention within a class?); (b) canonical spellings used consistently: 'Data Sheet' vs 'Datasheet', 'e-mail' vs 'email', 'set up' vs 'setup', phone-number formatting, 'ISO 9001' variants, company-name renderings; (c) the SKU-casing convention on rendered pages vs products-all.json values (report rendering drift only — data content is server-owned and out of scope).

Cross-page factual consistency: founding year, address, phone, fax, hours, minimum-order amount, stock quantity claims ('25M+ feet'), certifications — every rendering of each fact across all pages AND the noscript block in index.html AND titles/descriptions. Any two renderings that disagree is a finding (the noscript block is a DOCUMENTED second copy — drift there is still a finding, per its own comment: 'if the phone number changes, change it here too').

Alt/aria text quality: every img alt and aria-label read in full — empty-alt-on-decorative is deliberate (C43 class, check known_issues first); wrong/copy-pasted alt (alt describing a different image than measured — compare against the pass-0 screenshot of that element) is a B.

Truncation and slicing artifacts: PageMeta slices descriptions at 300 chars — check all 42 product descriptions for mid-word cuts rendered to crawlers; check any CSS line-clamp/ellipsis site for clipping that changes meaning.

Admin copy: every label, help text, warning, error, and confirm message in the textdump's admin pages — read in full for the same scans plus comprehensibility-to-Rick (a message that assumes technical vocabulary he does not have is a C with the exact wording quoted).

Record findings (typos/factual contradictions/misleading text -> B or C; batched drift classes -> one D each with instances[]), resolve any pass-4 candidates, validate, ledger, commit 'audit10(pass-4): ...', push, delete mirror credential.

scope_fences: copy STYLE opinions (tone, wordiness) are out — drift, errors, and contradictions are in
owner-typed content in data/*.json is server-owned: report rendering-layer issues and factual contradictions the SITE introduces, never propose editing his data
public-facing copy changes are owner decisions — findings quote exact current text and exact location, no rewrites offered
exit_criteria: textdump.json committed and covers every routes.json page
all mechanical scans run with their code committed as _harness/audit10-*.js
